prompt_en: A steaming bowl of beef pho on a wooden table.
refined_prompt: A steaming bowl of beef pho on a wooden table, surrounded by fresh herbs (like basil and mint), with thin rice noodles (bánh phở) and slices of beef floating in the savory broth. The aroma of the dish fills the air, and a few chili slices and bean sprouts are arranged artfully on the side. A spoon and a pair of chopsticks sit nearby, inviting you to take a delicious bite. Context: Pho is a beloved Vietnamese dish that brings people together, and its popularity extends beyond Vietnam to become a staple in many international cuisines. With its rich broth, springy noodles, and tender beef, pho is a culinary experience that transcends borders and cultures.
